score_scale: Each criterion scored 1-10. Overall = weighted mean. pass_threshold applies to the geometric-median aggregate across the panel.

criteria.name: Tempo sits in the meditative pocket
criteria.anchor: Lo-fi/chill lounge: 70-90 BPM, sweet spot 75-85, most-streamed lo-fi cluster 75-85; above 90 it drifts to boom-bap, ambient lo-fi can drop to 60-65 (BeatKey lo-fi guide; musicproductionwiki lo-fi hip hop; Soundtrap lo-fi production).
criteria.evidence: measure.py bpm + bpm_candidates. Accept a candidate inside the range at confidence >= 0.25.
criteria.guide: 10 = in-pocket candidate with confidence >= 0.35. 7 = in pocket at lower confidence or within 3 BPM of an edge. 4 = 5+ BPM outside. 1 = nothing in range.

criteria.name: The loop is the point
criteria.anchor: 4-8 bar loop, minimal development, small per-pass variation (filter movement, crackle shift, one melody note); repetition IS the product for 30-60 min album videos; transitions feel like the tide, not a wave (musicproductionwiki; violetrecording lo-fi guide; chill-lounge prompt craft notes).
criteria.evidence: rms_1s_spread_db (a loop-based texture shows moderate, rhythmic spread, not song-arc spread), duration_s, the style prompt.
criteria.guide: 10 = evidence consistent with a stable hypnotic loop (no hard drops; spread from gentle layer changes). 7 = mostly stable with one questionable event. 4 = song-arc dynamics (build/drop) on a loop claim. 1 = chaotic or broken texture.

criteria.name: Warmth and degradation are present, not decoration
criteria.anchor: Vinyl crackle bed at -18 to -22 dBFS (felt not heard), tape saturation on the master, high end rolled off 8-12 kHz (never deleted), swing 55-70% on hats (BeatKey; musicproductionwiki; dlklounge vinyl texture: crackle 2-8 kHz, hiss 5-15 kHz, saturation adds 2nd/3rd harmonics).
criteria.evidence: pct_energy_above_8khz — a warm chill-lounge master should show LOW single-digit-to-teen percent energy above 8 kHz; a bright modern top end is out of genre. Guide numbers: bright EDM/pop reads 20%+; warm lo-fi reads under ~12%.
criteria.guide: 10 = pct_energy_above_8khz <= 12 with a warmth claim. 7 = 12-18. 4 = 18-25 (bright modern top end on a warm claim = genre miss). 1 = 25+ or sterile-digital-flat with a warmth claim.

criteria.name: Jazz harmony, not pop triads
criteria.anchor: maj7/min7/dom9 and 9th/11th extensions, close voicings, ii-V-I canon (Dm7-G7-Cmaj7), voice-leading with shared notes (BeatKey; musicproductionwiki; violetrecording). Plain minor triads sound too basic for the genre.
criteria.evidence: The style prompt's harmony claim vs the corpus anchor. You cannot hear voicings from measurements; mark unverifiable if the prompt is silent.
criteria.guide: 10 = prompt claims extended jazz voicings AND nothing contradicts. 7 = claimed, unverified. 4 = only triads claimed or unison. 1 = harmony claim contradicts genre (e.g. big synth saw chords).

criteria.name: Master hits the lane loudness target
criteria.anchor: Long-form YouTube album lane + streaming: -14 LUFS mean (pipeline gate_loudness spec). Lo-fi should also feel soft-squashed: crest_factor typical 12-20 dB for dynamic material (musicproductionwiki: do not crush the master).
criteria.guide: 10 = within +/-1 dB of -14 and crest >= 10. 7 = within +/-3 dB, crest >= 8. 4 = outside 3-6 dB or crest 5-8. 1 = far off or crushed flat.

reject_signals: a vocal hook, chorus, or build-drop structure on a chill-lounge claim (out of genre - reject)
bright modern top end (pct_energy_above_8khz > 25) with a warmth/warm-degradation claim
measured tempo outside 60-95 BPM with no in-range candidate
hard abrupt digital ending on a loop claim (the lane needs loopable ends; fade or resolve)
